description.en: Planned whole-organism study featuring broad horseshoe carapace with swept rear wings and deep eye notches.
description.zh: 拟议全体生物研究：宽马蹄形甲壳、后掠侧翼与深眼切口。

scientific_scope.en: Genus-level living reconstruction planning study; named fossil morphology informs the proposal, with uncertain soft anatomy kept explicit.
scientific_scope.zh: 属级活体复原规划，参考具名化石形态；软组织等不确定部分须明确标注。

distinctness.en: Its distinguishing construction is broad horseshoe carapace with swept rear wings and deep eye notches; retain this geometry rather than treating it as a recolor, scale or pose variant.
distinctness.zh: 以宽马蹄形甲壳、后掠侧翼与深眼切口为独立造型依据；须保留这些结构差异，不能仅靠换色、缩放或姿势区别。

modeling_brief.en: Original low-poly direction: establish broad horseshoe carapace with swept rear wings and deep eye notches in the blockout, then preserve the largest silhouette breaks and openings. Simplify fine ornament and repeated elements without copying reference meshes; palette and presentation are artistic choices, not fossil evidence.
modeling_brief.zh: 原创低多边形方向：先以宽马蹄形甲壳、后掠侧翼与深眼切口搭建体块，再保留主要外轮廓转折与孔隙。细纹及重复结构可简化，不复制参考网格；配色与展示方式属于美术选择，并非化石证据。

uncertainty: The source supports the named form; coloration, posture, soft tissues and fine proportions are not all established.
reference_notes: The era is a representative planning interval, not a full stratigraphic range or a coexistence claim. Verify the selected species, locality and specimen before a place-specific scene.

sources.title: Cambroraster falcatus — ROM Burgess Shale
sources.supports: Named taxon's fossil occurrence and external morphology in the Description section; reconstruction caveats retained in each asset.
